title: Adaptive relaxed CQ algorithm with dynamic stepsizes for the split feasibility problem
summary: In this paper, we propose a relaxed CQ algorithm with dynamic stepsizes for the split feasibility problem (SFP), where the relaxed parameters are chosen adaptively. We establish the weak convergence of the proposed algorithm under standard assumptions and further derive its linear convergence under the bounded linear regularity property of the SFP. Numerical results on LASSO problem demonstrate that the adaptively over-relaxed CQ algorithm with dynamic stepsizes outperforms the dynamic CQ algorithm proposed in [10].
